title: Driving collective RPA modes by a time-dependent Dyson map
summary: We study a time-dependent non-Hermitian generalisation of the Schütte-Da~Providência model describing a bosonic mode coupled to collective particle-hole excitations. Using a time-dependent Dyson map, we construct a Hermitian counterpart and reduce the collective fermionic sector by means of the random phase approximation (RPA). The resulting dynamics is mapped to two time-dependent harmonic-oscillator branches with instantaneous RPA frequencies $W_\pm(t)$.
